task.title: GPU: LongCLIP resolution+P4b speed/VRAM probe
task.body:
GPU UUID: GPU-27ff99d6-d77d-2226-a4b5-7a11b8ef6bdd
CUDA device: cuda:0 via CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0
Lock: /tmp/hermes-gpu-0.lock
Repository: /home/krz/PycharmProjects/gemma-stable-difussion
Git commit: b7f45d317b4f46d4e6ebd8d914aa1c4cc0b6d0d6
Working directory: /home/krz/PycharmProjects/gemma-stable-difussion
Purpose: speed/VRAM probe after both resolution+P4 smoke cards pass and before full Monet4 arms start.
Command:
./scripts/run_longclip_sara_speed_probe_gpu_queue.sh GPU-27ff99d6-d77d-2226-a4b5-7a11b8ef6bdd
Probe candidates, all P4b RoPE / resolution enabled / same /mnt/e Unsplash+Monet data paths:
1. config_longclip_sara_15pct_plus_monet4_resolution_p4b_rope_speed_probe_b8_acc1.json (batch=8, accum=1, effective=8)
2. config_longclip_sara_15pct_plus_monet4_resolution_p4b_rope_speed_probe_b6_acc1.json (batch=6, accum=1, effective=6)
3. config_longclip_sara_15pct_plus_monet4_resolution_p4b_rope_speed_probe_b4_acc2.json (batch=4, accum=2, effective=8 baseline)
Outputs:
- logs/queued_longclip_resolution_p4b_speed_probe_summary.tsv
- logs/queued_longclip_resolution_p4b_speed_probe_<label>.log
- logs/queued_longclip_resolution_p4b_speed_probe_<label>_gpu_mem.csv
- output_longclip_sara_15pct_plus_monet4_resolution_p4b_rope_speed_probe_*/longclip_sara_unet_attn2_kv_sparse.pt
Acceptance:
1. Run exactly the command above from the working directory; do not launch outside /tmp/hermes-gpu-0.lock.
2. Runner verifies GPU UUID GPU-27ff99d6-d77d-2226-a4b5-7a11b8ef6bdd and refuses unexpected compute processes.
3. At least one candidate exits 0; preserve failed larger-batch logs as evidence instead of retrying blindly.
4. Summary TSV exists and records label, config, log, monitor, exit_code, elapsed_seconds, peak_gpu_mem_mib, status.
5. For each successful candidate, checkpoint exists and validation_gate has passed=true, heldout_ran=true, heldout_passed=true, short_prompt_ran=true, short_prompt_passed=true, finite metrics.
6. Recommend the full-run batch/accum choice in the card handoff. Use the same choice for P4a and P4b full runs if configs are updated later.
Decision rule:
- Prefer b8/accum1 if it succeeds and is >=15% faster per optimizer step than baseline without VRAM exhaustion.
- Else prefer b6/accum1 only if clearly faster and acceptable despite effective batch change.
- Else keep existing b4/accum2 full configs.
Failure handling:
- Exit 75 means lock unavailable; comment/block, do not bypass.
- Exit 76 means unexpected GPU process; comment/block with nvidia-smi evidence, do not kill unless explicitly instructed.
- OOM on b8/b6 is not a card failure if a smaller candidate succeeds; preserve logs and continue.
